name: Petra - sear and turn
quote_source: Text to Motion dialog: Motion Prime, slider 6, Generate button 10
prompt: An upright chef stands still at a waist-high stove. Feet stay planted. Left hand steadies a pan handle. Right hand holds cooking tongs: reach gently forward, close them on a piece of meat, lift slightly, turn the wrist to roll the meat, lower it into the pan, release, return to a relaxed ready pose. Small controlled movements. No walking, crouching, dancing or talking. Full body.
acceptance: Inspect the result on Petra's own rig. Feet planted, natural shoulders/elbows/wrists, clear reach-turn-return performance, no apron stretch, continuous transitions, and real tongs/pan contact in the kitchen. No other body jobs until Petra's route is proven.
